t.why: It uses the US dollar as its currency and is one of the world's top banana exporters.
t.rel: It lies between Colombia and Peru. It fought border wars with Peru until 1995 but settled them with a 1998 peace deal. As violence by drug gangs spilling over from Colombia has grown, it has joined its neighbors in a common response.
t.know: It has the Galapagos Islands, which inspired Darwin's work on evolution.
t.etext: Crude oil, bananas and shrimp are its main exports. It uses the US dollar as its own currency. Rising drug-gang violence has dampened investment and tourism.
